description: This file defines functions for managing an array of object IDs (oids), including operations such as append, sort, lookup, clear, iterate, and filter. It is part of a larger system related to git objects.

methods.name: void oid_array_append(struct oid_array * array,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Appends a new object ID to the array, reallocating memory as needed, setting algorithm if not set, and marking the array as unsorted.

methods.name: void oid_array_sort(struct oid_array * array)
methods.description: Sorts the object ID array if it is not already sorted, using a custom comparison function.

methods.name: int oid_array_lookup(struct oid_array * array,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a given object ID in the array, sorting the array first if necessary.

methods.name: void oid_array_clear(struct oid_array * array)
methods.description: Clears the object ID array, freeing memory and resetting counters.

methods.name: int oid_array_for_each(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn fn,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID in the array, calling a provided callback function.

methods.name: int oid_array_for_each_unique(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn fn,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over each unique object ID in the array, calling a provided callback function.

methods.name: void oid_array_filter(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn want,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Filters the object IDs in the array based on a predicate callback, removing those that do not satisfy the condition.

methods.name: const struct object_id * oid_access(size_t index,const void * table)
int void_hashcmp(const void * va,const void * vb)

ctags.name: oid_access
ctags.pattern: /^static const struct object_id *oid_access(size_t index, const void *table)$/
